paper.title: Algorithm 439: Product Type Three-point Gauss-Legendre Simpson Integration

claim.text: TEST01 (integral of F(X)*G(X) from -1 to 1, F=1, G=1/(1+x**2)), table row N = 10, VINT = 2.65082, as printed by the shipped reference output Fortran/Dp/Drivers/res. Registered by scout from the artifact's own output. Tolerance 1e-5 absolute, fixed before any run.

attempt: G1: the archive's own Makefile, unchanged, fails in the sandbox because no f77 exists (no Fortran compiler in the base sandbox). The compiler (gfortran 16.2.0, conda-forge) is installed in the sandbox during --fetch. The archive's Drivers Makefile still cannot build as shipped: it compiles `src.f` from Drivers, but the archive ships it in ../Src. The build uses VPATH=../Src (so make finds the prerequisite) and a build shim that maps the one compiler argument src.f to ../Src/src.f. The link needs the gfortran runtime and libm (SRCLIBS). No archive file is edited. The build then runs the archive's own driver. Its N=10 row matches the shipped res exactly. Two passes from a fresh unpack gave identical output.
